1 // Gandalf advisor — canary harness foundation (Wave 1 / GATE-0).
2 //
3 // This is the SHAPE + RUNG-CONSISTENCY substrate every later wave's canary builds on.
4 // It owns deterministic, field-level assertions only; label/semantic TRUTH is the
5 // advisory layer's job (PRINCIPLE-D). Zero external dependencies — it ships a compact
6 // JSON-Schema-subset validator so `node --test` runs with no install step.
7 //
8 // Public surface (consumed by the wave test suites):
9 //   RUNG_LADDER, TIER_LADDER, VALUE_LADDER, SEVERITY_LADDER  — ordered low→high
10 //   rungIndex / tierIndex / rungAtLeast / tierAtMost          — ladder helpers
11 //   isPopulated                                               — "field carries a value"
12 //   validateShape(output)                                     — → string[] of errors
13 //   assertSchemaConformant(output)                            — throws on shape error
14 //   assertReasoningBeforeVerdict(obj, label)                  — key-order invariant
15 //   assertCaps(output)                                        — nitpick/elevation caps
16 //   assertRungCeiling(finding, {field, minRung})              — rung-gated field assertion
17 //   assertDiagnoseCoreProvenance(finding)                     — B5: diagnose exclusive to the core
18 //   assertDiagnoseSeam(output)                                — B5 over every finding in an output
19 //   assertTierCeiling(item, {cross_model, where})             — B-ceiling on one tier-bearing item
20 //   assertCeiling(output)                                     — B-ceiling over an output (W3)
21 //   assertSituateScoreCeiling(finding)                        — SITUATE no self-CORROBORATED (W3)
22 //   assertSituateSeam(output)                                 — SITUATE cap over every finding (W3)
23 //   assertHonestRefutation(elevation)                         — B-honesty on one elevation (W4)
24 //   assertRefutationSeam(output)                              — B-honesty over every elevation (W4)
25 //   assertBoundedPremortem(finding)                           — B3: premortem ≠ Oranges-engine (W5)
26 //   assertForwardLooking(finding)                             — B9: not-yet-present future-state (W5)
27 //   assertAnticipateSeam(output)                              — B3+B9 over every anticipate finding (W5)
28 //   assertNoIdeation(finding)                                 — B1: zero ideation (ideation is Jumper's) (W6)
29 //   assertNoSilentDegradation(output)                         — B6: no per-item degraded under top-level clean (W6)
30 //   assertHonestSynthesis(output)                             — B8: every leg labelled, rung ≤ envelope (W6)
31 //   assertScoreLabelSeam(output)                              — B1+B6+B8 over a whole output (W6)
32 //   assertIncrement1Conformant(output)                        — the FULL Increment-1 canary set (W7)
33 //   assertConformant(output)                                  — umbrella: shape + order + caps
34 //   SCHEMA, CONSTANTS                                         — the committed artifacts

63 // --- Ladders (low → high). Schema enums mirror these; harness.test.mjs asserts agreement. ---
64 export const RUNG_LADDER = ['REFUTED', 'UNVERIFIED', 'CLAIMED', 'CORROBORATED', 'OBSERVED'];
65 export const TIER_LADDER = ['SPECULATIVE', 'PROMISING', 'GROUNDED'];
66 export const VALUE_LADDER = ['low', 'medium', 'high'];
67 export const SEVERITY_LADDER = ['minor', 'major', 'critical'];
68 
69 export function rungIndex(rung) {
70   const i = RUNG_LADDER.indexOf(rung);
71   if (i === -1) throw new Error(`harness: unknown rung ${JSON.stringify(rung)}`);
72   return i;
73 }
74 export function tierIndex(tier) {
75   const i = TIER_LADDER.indexOf(tier);
76   if (i === -1) throw new Error(`harness: unknown tier ${JSON.stringify(tier)}`);
77   return i;
78 }
79 export function rungAtLeast(rung, minRung) {
80   return rungIndex(rung) >= rungIndex(minRung);
81 }
82 export function tierAtMost(tier, maxTier) {
83   return tierIndex(tier) <= tierIndex(maxTier);
84 }

86 // A field "carries a value" (is gated) when present and non-empty.
87 export function isPopulated(v) {
88   if (v === undefined || v === null) return false;
89   if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0;
90   if (typeof v === 'string') return v.trim() !== '';
91   if (typeof v === 'object') return Object.keys(v).length > 0;
92   return true; // numbers, booleans
93 }

95 // --- Zero-dependency JSON-Schema-subset validator -------------------------------------
96 // Supports: type (string|array), required, properties, items, enum, const,
97 // minimum/maximum, minItems/maxItems, additionalProperties:false. No $ref (schema is inlined).
98 function typeOk(value, t) {
99   switch (t) {
100     case 'string': return typeof value === 'string';
101     case 'boolean': return typeof value === 'boolean';
102     case 'number': return typeof value === 'number';
103     case 'integer': return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value);
104     case 'array': return Array.isArray(value);
105     case 'object': return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
106     case 'null': return value === null;
107     default: throw new Error(`harness: unsupported schema type ${JSON.stringify(t)}`);
108   }
109 }
110 function describe(v) {
111   if (v === null) return 'null';
112   if (Array.isArray(v)) return 'array';
113   return typeof v;
114 }
115 function validate(value, schema, path, errors) {
116   if (schema.type !== undefined) {
117     const types = Array.isArray(schema.type) ? schema.type : [schema.type];
118     if (!types.some((t) => typeOk(value, t))) {
119       errors.push(`${path}: expected type ${types.join('|')}, got ${describe(value)}`);
120       return; // type mismatch — deeper checks would be noise
121     }
122   }
123   if (schema.const !== undefined && value !== schema.const) {
124     errors.push(`${path}: expected const ${JSON.stringify(schema.const)}, got ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
125   }
126   if (schema.enum !== undefined && !schema.enum.includes(value)) {
127     errors.push(`${path}: ${JSON.stringify(value)} not in enum [${schema.enum.join(', ')}]`);
128   }
129   if (typeof value === 'number') {
130     if (schema.minimum !== undefined && value < schema.minimum) errors.push(`${path}: ${value} < minimum ${schema.minimum}`);
131     if (schema.maximum !== undefined && value > schema.maximum) errors.push(`${path}: ${value} > maximum ${schema.maximum}`);
132   }
133   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
134     if (schema.minItems !== undefined && value.length < schema.minItems) errors.push(`${path}: ${value.length} items < minItems ${schema.minItems}`);
135     if (schema.maxItems !== undefined && value.length > schema.maxItems) errors.push(`${path}: ${value.length} items > maxItems ${schema.maxItems}`);
136     if (schema.items) value.forEach((v, i) => validate(v, schema.items, `${path}[${i}]`, errors));
137   }
138   if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
139     if (schema.required) {
140       for (const k of schema.required) if (!(k in value)) errors.push(`${path}: missing required key '${k}'`);
141     }
142     if (schema.properties) {
143       for (const [k, sub] of Object.entries(schema.properties)) if (k in value) validate(value[k], sub, `${path}.${k}`, errors);
144     }
145     if (schema.additionalProperties === false && schema.properties) {
146       for (const k of Object.keys(value)) if (!(k in schema.properties)) errors.push(`${path}: unexpected key '${k}'`);
147     }
148   }
149 }
150 
151 /** Validate an advisor output against the committed typed schema. Returns an array of
152  *  error strings (empty array ⇒ shape-conformant). Pure; never throws on data. */
153 export function validateShape(output, schema = SCHEMA) {
154   const errors = [];
155   validate(output, schema, '$', errors);
156   return errors;
157 }
158 
159 export function assertSchemaConformant(output) {
160   const errors = validateShape(output);
161   if (errors.length) {
162     throw new Error(`schema-conformance FAILED:\n  - ${errors.join('\n  - ')}`);
163   }
164 }

166 // --- reasoning-before-verdict invariant ------------------------------------------------
167 /** Assert that, in `obj`'s own key order, 'reasoning' appears before 'verdict' and both
168  *  are present. JS preserves string-key insertion order, so this is deterministic. */
169 export function assertReasoningBeforeVerdict(obj, label = '$') {
170   if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(obj)) {
171     throw new Error(`reasoning-before-verdict: ${label} is not an object`);
172   }
173   const keys = Object.keys(obj);
174   const r = keys.indexOf('reasoning');
175   const v = keys.indexOf('verdict');
176   if (r === -1) throw new Error(`reasoning-before-verdict: ${label} missing 'reasoning'`);
177   if (v === -1) throw new Error(`reasoning-before-verdict: ${label} missing 'verdict'`);
178   if (r > v) throw new Error(`reasoning-before-verdict: ${label} has 'verdict' (pos ${v}) before 'reasoning' (pos ${r})`);
179 }
180 
181 // --- nitpick / elevation caps ----------------------------------------------------------
182 export function assertCaps(output) {
183   const { max_nitpicks, max_elevations } = CONSTANTS.output_caps;
184   const nN = Array.isArray(output.nitpicks) ? output.nitpicks.length : 0;
185   const nE = Array.isArray(output.elevations) ? output.elevations.length : 0;
186   if (nN > max_nitpicks) throw new Error(`nitpick cap exceeded: ${nN} > ${max_nitpicks}`);
187   if (nE > max_elevations) throw new Error(`elevation cap exceeded: ${nE} > ${max_elevations}`);
188 }

190 // --- rung-gated field assertion (the core Wave-1 capability) ----------------------------
191 /** Assert that a rung-gated field obeys its rung ceiling: if `finding[field]` carries a
192  *  value, the finding's rung must be at or above `minRung` on the evidence ladder.
193  *  A finding that asserts a higher-evidence field while sitting on a lower rung FAILS
194  *  (this is the field-level, rung-gated assertion the harness is built to support). */
195 export function assertRungCeiling(finding, { field, minRung }) {
196   if (finding === null || typeof finding !== 'object') {
197     throw new Error(`rung-ceiling: target is not an object`);
198   }
199   rungIndex(minRung); // validate minRung is a known rung
200   if (!isPopulated(finding[field])) return; // field absent ⇒ nothing gated
201   const rung = finding.rung;
202   if (rung === undefined) {
203     throw new Error(`rung-ceiling: finding populates '${field}' but carries no rung`);
204   }
205   if (!rungAtLeast(rung, minRung)) {
206     throw new Error(
207       `rung-ceiling: finding '${finding.id ?? '?'}' populates '${field}' (requires rung ≥ ${minRung}) but is at rung ${rung}`
208     );
209   }
210 }
211 
212 // --- B5: diagnose exclusive to the vetted core (the Wave-2 capability) -------------------
213 /** B5 (diagnose exclusive to core). Assert that a `kind:'diagnose'` finding came from the
214  *  vetted diagnose core (PROTOCOL v2), not re-derived inline and not sourced from a
215  *  commissioned skill. A diagnose finding FAILS when it: (a) carries no `gandalf_core`
216  *  provenance, (b) carries a `gandalf_core` envelope that does not name the vetted-core
217  *  protocol (re-derived inline / foreign source), or (c) carries an external commission id.
218  *  Non-diagnose findings are not gated by B5 (their provenance is a later wave's seam). */
219 export function assertDiagnoseCoreProvenance(finding) {
220   if (finding === null || typeof finding !== 'object' || Array.isArray(finding)) {
221     throw new Error('B5 diagnose-provenance: target is not an object');
222   }
223   if (finding.kind !== 'diagnose') return; // only diagnose findings are gated by B5
224   const id = finding.id ?? '?';
225   const prov = finding.gandalf_core;
226   if (!isPopulated(prov)) {
227     throw new Error(`B5 diagnose-provenance: diagnose finding '${id}' carries no gandalf_core provenance (re-derived inline?)`);
228   }
229   const protocol = typeof prov === 'object' && !Array.isArray(prov) ? prov.protocol : prov;
230   if (protocol !== GANDALF_CORE_PROTOCOL) {
231     throw new Error(
232       `B5 diagnose-provenance: diagnose finding '${id}' gandalf_core provenance is not the vetted core (${GANDALF_CORE_PROTOCOL}); got ${JSON.stringify(protocol)} (re-derived inline / foreign source)`
233     );
234   }
235   for (const f of EXTERNAL_COMMISSION_FIELDS) {
236     if (isPopulated(finding[f])) {
237       throw new Error(`B5 diagnose-provenance: diagnose finding '${id}' carries external commission id '${f}' — diagnosis is exclusive to the vetted core`);
238     }
239   }
240 }
241 
242 /** Apply B5 to every finding in an advisor output: the vetted diagnose core is the SOLE
243  *  diagnosis source, so no `kind:'diagnose'` finding may exist without vetted-core
244  *  provenance. Throws on the first violation. */
245 export function assertDiagnoseSeam(output) {
246   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
247   findings.forEach((f) => assertDiagnoseCoreProvenance(f));
248 }

250 // --- B-ceiling: single-family ⇒ max tier PROMISING (the Wave-3 capability) ----------------
251 /** B-ceiling on a single tier-bearing item (elevation or risk_label). On a single-family run
252  *  (`cross_model:false`) the max achievable tier is PROMISING — the deterministic embodiment
253  *  of the CBS-5 re-stamp: a GROUNDED stamp is unreachable without a cross-family refuter, so
254  *  it FAILS. When the run is NOT single-family (cross_model !== false) the ceiling does not
255  *  bite. An item with no `tier` is not gated. `where` labels the failure site. */
256 export function assertTierCeiling(item, { cross_model, where = 'item' } = {}) {
257   if (cross_model !== false) return; // ceiling only bites on a single-family substrate
258   if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object') return;
259   const tier = item.tier;
260   if (tier === undefined) return;
261   if (!tierAtMost(tier, 'PROMISING')) {
262     throw new Error(
263       `B-ceiling: ${where} is stamped ${tier} on a cross_model:false run — the single-family substrate ceiling is PROMISING (GROUNDED is unreachable without a cross-family refuter)`
264     );
265   }
266 }
267 
268 /** B-ceiling over a whole advisor output: when the run is single-family
269  *  (`output.cross_model === false`), NO elevation and NO risk_label may be stamped GROUNDED;
270  *  the max achievable tier is PROMISING. Throws on the first violation. */
271 export function assertCeiling(output) {
272   const cross_model = output?.cross_model;
273   const elevations = Array.isArray(output?.elevations) ? output.elevations : [];
274   elevations.forEach((e, i) =>
275     assertTierCeiling(e, { cross_model, where: `elevations[${i}] '${e?.id ?? '?'}'` })
276   );
277   const riskLabels = Array.isArray(output?.risk_labels) ? output.risk_labels : [];
278   riskLabels.forEach((r, i) =>
279     assertTierCeiling(r, { cross_model, where: `risk_labels[${i}] leg '${r?.leg ?? '?'}'` })
280   );
281 }
282 
283 // --- SITUATE honesty cap: no self-CORROBORATED (the Wave-3 capability) ---------------------
284 /** The SITUATE scoring cap. A `kind:'situate'` finding's facts come from a commissioned
285  *  researchPrime; on a single-family substrate that commission is same-family and earns NO
286  *  independent-origin credit, so the finding may NOT self-corroborate. This asserts:
287  *    (a) NO self-CORROBORATED — a situate finding at rung ≥ CORROBORATED must carry
288  *        `independent_origin:true` (only a cross-family commission earns it); otherwise it is
289  *        capped at SITUATE_SELF_MAX_RUNG (CLAIMED) and FAILS here; and
290  *    (b) unverifiable ⇒ handoff — a situate finding whose `facts_verified` is false must carry
291  *        a `needs_verification` researchPrime handoff (the unverifiable fact is routed out,
292  *        never asserted as real).
293  *  Non-situate findings are not gated (their provenance is another leg's seam). */
294 export function assertSituateScoreCeiling(finding) {
295   if (finding === null || typeof finding !== 'object' || Array.isArray(finding)) {
296     throw new Error('B-situate: target is not an object');
297   }
298   if (finding.kind !== SITUATE_KIND) return; // only situate findings are gated here
299   const id = finding.id ?? '?';
300   const independent = finding.independent_origin === true;
301   const rung = finding.rung;
302   // (a) no self-CORROBORATED: without independent origin, the rung is capped at CLAIMED.
303   if (!independent && rung !== undefined && rungAtLeast(rung, 'CORROBORATED')) {
304     throw new Error(
305       `B-situate: situate finding '${id}' is stamped ${rung} with no independent-origin credit — no self-CORROBORATED (a same-family commission caps the rung at ${SITUATE_SELF_MAX_RUNG})`
306     );
307   }
308   // (b) unverifiable ⇒ researchPrime needs_verification handoff.
309   if (finding.facts_verified === false && !isPopulated(finding.needs_verification)) {
310     throw new Error(
311       `B-situate: situate finding '${id}' has unverified facts but carries no needs_verification handoff (an unverifiable correspondence must be routed to a researchPrime handoff, not asserted as real)`
312     );
313   }
314 }
315 
316 /** Apply the SITUATE cap to every finding in an advisor output. Throws on the first
317  *  violation; an output with no situate findings trivially passes. */
318 export function assertSituateSeam(output) {
319   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
320   findings.forEach((f) => assertSituateScoreCeiling(f));
321 }

323 // --- B-honesty: the NS4 refutation-discipline spine (the Wave-4 capability) ----------------
324 /** B-honesty on a single elevation. NS4: a vetted suggestion above the SPECULATIVE floor must
325  *  have survived an INDEPENDENT named-defeater refutation. This asserts, deterministically:
326  *    • BELOW the refuter-firing threshold (value_if_true < high AND severity < major): the
327  *      elevation gets no independent refuter, so it must ship SPECULATIVE carrying the
328  *      "no independent refutation ran" stamp — being stamped above SPECULATIVE FAILS, and a
329  *      SPECULATIVE one with no stamp FAILS (no silent drop);
330  *    • FIRES the threshold and stamped SPECULATIVE: it is the honest un-refuted floor and must
331  *      carry the stamp (else FAIL); and
332  *    • FIRES the threshold and stamped above SPECULATIVE: it must carry a NAMED concrete
333  *      defeater (`what_would_refute_it`, not a self-rated confidence word) AND a
334  *      `refutation_provenance` envelope (an independent refuter ran) — else it FAILS
335  *      (auto-downgrade to SPECULATIVE; see seam/refute.mjs `vetElevationRefutation`).
336  *  An item with no `tier` is not gated (not a tier-bearing elevation). */
337 export function assertHonestRefutation(elevation) {
338   if (elevation === null || typeof elevation !== 'object' || Array.isArray(elevation)) {
339     throw new Error('B-honesty: target is not an object');
340   }
341   const tier = elevation.tier;
342   if (tier === undefined) return; // not a tier-bearing elevation
343   tierIndex(tier); // validate the tier is a known tier
344   const id = elevation.id ?? '?';
345   const fires = firesRefuter(elevation);
346   const aboveFloor = !tierAtMost(tier, 'SPECULATIVE');
347 
348   if (!fires) {
349     // Below the firing threshold: no independent refuter runs ⇒ ship SPECULATIVE + the stamp.
350     if (aboveFloor) {
351       throw new Error(
352         `B-honesty: elevation '${id}' is below the refuter-firing threshold (value_if_true < high and severity < major) but is stamped ${tier} above SPECULATIVE — a below-threshold finding earns no independent refuter and must ship SPECULATIVE with the "${NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP}" stamp`
353       );
354     }
355     if (!hasNoIndependentRefutationStamp(elevation)) {
356       throw new Error(
357         `B-honesty: elevation '${id}' ships SPECULATIVE (no independent refuter fired) but carries no "${NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP}" stamp (no silent drop)`
358       );
359     }
360     return;
361   }
362 
363   // Fires the threshold but stamped at the floor: the honest un-refuted floor must be stamped.
364   if (!aboveFloor) {
365     if (!hasNoIndependentRefutationStamp(elevation)) {
366       throw new Error(
367         `B-honesty: elevation '${id}' is SPECULATIVE but carries no "${NO_INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION_STAMP}" stamp (a high-value elevation that did not survive an independent refuter must be stamped, not silently dropped)`
368       );
369     }
370     return;
371   }
372 
373   // Fires the threshold and stamped above SPECULATIVE: requires a named defeater + provenance.
374   if (!isNamedDefeater(elevation.what_would_refute_it)) {
375     throw new Error(
376       `B-honesty: elevation '${id}' is stamped ${tier} but its what_would_refute_it is a self-rated confidence word / empty, not a NAMED concrete defeater — FAILS (auto-downgrade to SPECULATIVE)`
377     );
378   }
379   if (!isPopulated(elevation.refutation_provenance)) {
380     throw new Error(
381       `B-honesty: elevation '${id}' is stamped ${tier} but carries no refutation_provenance (no INDEPENDENT named-defeater refuter ran) — FAILS (auto-downgrade to SPECULATIVE)`
382     );
383   }
384 }
385 
386 /** Apply B-honesty to every elevation in an advisor output. Throws on the first violation; an
387  *  output with no elevations trivially passes. */
388 export function assertRefutationSeam(output) {
389   const elevations = Array.isArray(output?.elevations) ? output.elevations : [];
390   elevations.forEach((e) => assertHonestRefutation(e));
391 }

393 // --- B3: bounded premortem ≠ Crucible's Oranges-engine (the Wave-5 capability) -------------
394 /** B3 on a single anticipate finding. Gandalf's ANTICIPATE is a BOUNDED premortem on a SINGLE
395  *  effort (subject_cardinality == 1), NOT Crucible's multi-plan counterfactual-cost engine. A
396  *  `kind:'anticipate'` finding FAILS B3 when it carries a regret/counterfactual-cost field
397  *  (ORANGES_ENGINE_FIELDS) OR `subject_cardinality > 1` — that work is Crucible's, so it routes to
398  *  a Crucible commission (seam/anticipate.mjs `commissionCrucible`). Non-anticipate findings are
399  *  not gated by B3. (Cross-path cost reasoning carried only in PROSE is the advisory layer's job —
400  *  `flagCrossPathCostReasoning`, isolated from this gate by PRINCIPLE-D.) */
401 export function assertBoundedPremortem(finding) {
402   if (finding === null || typeof finding !== 'object' || Array.isArray(finding)) {
403     throw new Error('B3 bounded-premortem: target is not an object');
404   }
405   if (finding.kind !== ANTICIPATE_KIND) return; // only anticipate findings are gated by B3
406   const id = finding.id ?? '?';
407   if (finding.subject_cardinality !== undefined && finding.subject_cardinality !== BOUNDED_SUBJECT_CARDINALITY) {
408     throw new Error(
409       `B3 bounded-premortem: anticipate finding '${id}' has subject_cardinality ${JSON.stringify(finding.subject_cardinality)} (≠ ${BOUNDED_SUBJECT_CARDINALITY}) — a multi-path read is Crucible's Oranges-engine; route to a Crucible commission`
410     );
411   }
412   for (const f of ORANGES_ENGINE_FIELDS) {
413     if (isPopulated(finding[f])) {
414       throw new Error(
415         `B3 bounded-premortem: anticipate finding '${id}' carries the regret/counterfactual-cost field '${f}' — counterfactual-cost-across-paths is Crucible's engine, not Gandalf's bounded premortem; route to a Crucible commission`
416       );
417     }
418   }
419 }
420 
421 // --- B9: an anticipation is a not-yet-present future-state (the Wave-5 capability) ----------
422 /** B9 on a single anticipate finding. NS3: an anticipation surfaces a COMING problem — a
423  *  not-yet-present `future_state_condition` plus the `enabling_assumption` that would bring it on.
424  *  A `kind:'anticipate'` finding FAILS B9 when it is PRESENT-TENSE — it lacks a populated,
425  *  well-formed future-state condition + enabling assumption (per seam/anticipate.mjs
426  *  `isForwardLookingAnticipation`). Non-anticipate findings are not gated by B9. */
427 export function assertForwardLooking(finding) {
428   if (finding === null || typeof finding !== 'object' || Array.isArray(finding)) {
429     throw new Error('B9 forward-looking: target is not an object');
430   }
431   if (finding.kind !== ANTICIPATE_KIND) return; // only anticipate findings are gated by B9
432   const id = finding.id ?? '?';
433   if (!isForwardLookingAnticipation(finding)) {
434     throw new Error(
435       `B9 forward-looking: anticipate finding '${id}' is present-tense — it carries no populated, well-formed future_state_condition + enabling_assumption (an anticipation is a not-yet-present future state, never a present-tense observation)`
436     );
437   }
438 }
439 
440 /** Apply B3 + B9 to every finding in an advisor output: every `kind:'anticipate'` finding must be
441  *  a bounded premortem (B3) AND forward-looking (B9). Throws on the first violation; an output
442  *  with no anticipate findings trivially passes. */
443 export function assertAnticipateSeam(output) {
444   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
445   findings.forEach((f) => {
446     assertBoundedPremortem(f);
447     assertForwardLooking(f);
448   });
449 }
450 
451 // --- B1: zero ideation — Gandalf does not brainstorm (the Wave-6 capability) ---------------
452 /** B1 on a single item. NS6 anti-drift: Gandalf's value is INSIGHT (understand / situate /
453  *  anticipate), NOT the open-ended generation of new ideas/extensions — that is Jumper's. An
454  *  "ideate"-class item (a divergent/brainstorm `kind`, or a finding carrying an idea-generation
455  *  field, per seam/score-label.mjs `isIdeationFinding`) FAILS B1. A grounded diagnose/situate/
456  *  anticipate finding is not gated. (Judging whether prose is genuinely divergent is the advisory
457  *  layer's job — PRINCIPLE-D; the gate owns the structural ideate-class signal.) */
458 export function assertNoIdeation(item) {
459   if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item)) {
460     throw new Error('B1 zero-ideation: target is not an object');
461   }
462   if (isIdeationFinding(item)) {
463     throw new Error(
464       `B1 zero-ideation: item '${item.id ?? '?'}' is a divergent/brainstorm ideate-class finding — open-ended idea generation is Jumper's, not Gandalf's (Gandalf delivers grounded insight: understand / situate / anticipate)`
465     );
466   }
467 }
468 
469 /** Apply B1 to every finding AND elevation in an advisor output (the suggestion surfaces where an
470  *  ideation drift would land). Throws on the first violation; an output with none trivially passes. */
471 export function assertNoIdeationSeam(output) {
472   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
473   const elevations = Array.isArray(output?.elevations) ? output.elevations : [];
474   findings.forEach((f) => assertNoIdeation(f));
475   elevations.forEach((e) => assertNoIdeation(e));
476 }
477 
478 // --- B6: no silent degradation (the Wave-6 capability) -------------------------------------
479 /** B6 on a whole output. If any item ran DEGRADED (`degraded:true`), the top-level output MUST own
480  *  it (`degraded:true`). A per-item `degraded:true` under a top-level `degraded:false` is a SILENT
481  *  degradation and FAILS (per seam/score-label.mjs `hasSilentDegradation`). Throws on the first
482  *  offending item; an honest output (top-level owns it, or nothing degraded) passes. */
483 export function assertNoSilentDegradation(output) {
484   if (output === null || typeof output !== 'object' || Array.isArray(output)) {
485     throw new Error('B6 no-silent-degradation: target is not an object');
486   }
487   if (!hasSilentDegradation(output)) return;
488   const first = degradedItems(output)[0];
489   throw new Error(
490     `B6 no-silent-degradation: ${first.where} ('${first.item.id ?? first.item.leg ?? '?'}') ran degraded:true but the top-level output is degraded:false — degradation must be surfaced at the top level, never silent`
491   );
492 }
493 
494 // --- B8: honest synthesis (the Wave-6 capability) ------------------------------------------
495 /** B8 on a whole output. Honest synthesis: (a) every leg the run REPORTS (a diagnose/situate/
496  *  anticipate finding is present) MUST appear in `risk_labels`; and (b) a risk_label's rung may NOT
497  *  exceed its leg's EVIDENTIAL ENVELOPE — the strongest rung any finding in the leg reached (a
498  *  synthesis may not claim more evidence than its leg carries — carry rung at-or-below source). A
499  *  missing leg OR an over-claiming risk_label FAILS. Throws on the first violation. */
500 export function assertHonestSynthesis(output) {
501   if (output === null || typeof output !== 'object' || Array.isArray(output)) {
502     throw new Error('B8 honest-synthesis: target is not an object');
503   }
504   const riskLabels = Array.isArray(output.risk_labels) ? output.risk_labels : [];
505   const labelledLegs = new Set(riskLabels.map((r) => (r && typeof r === 'object' ? r.leg : undefined)));
506   // (a) every present leg must be labelled.
507   for (const leg of legsPresent(output)) {
508     if (!labelledLegs.has(leg)) {
509       throw new Error(
510         `B8 honest-synthesis: leg '${leg}' is present in the findings but absent from risk_labels — honest synthesis must label every leg it reports (no silent omission)`
511       );
512     }
513   }
514   // (b) no risk_label may out-claim its leg's evidential envelope.
515   riskLabels.forEach((r, i) => {
516     if (r === null || typeof r !== 'object' || r.rung === undefined) return; // no rung ⇒ nothing to over-claim
517     const envelope = legEnvelopeRung(output, r.leg);
518     if (envelope === null) return; // a label for a leg with no rung-bearing finding — not gated here
519     if (rungIndex(r.rung) > rungIndex(envelope)) {
520       throw new Error(
521         `B8 honest-synthesis: risk_labels[${i}] for leg '${r.leg}' is stamped rung ${r.rung} but the leg's evidential envelope is ${envelope} — a synthesis may not claim more evidence than its leg carries (carry rung at-or-below source)`
522       );
523     }
524   });
525 }
526 
527 /** Apply the Wave-6 seam (B1 + B6 + B8) over a whole advisor output. Throws on the first
528  *  violation; an honest output passes all three. */
529 export function assertScoreLabelSeam(output) {
530   assertNoIdeationSeam(output);
531   assertNoSilentDegradation(output);
532   assertHonestSynthesis(output);
533 }
534 
535 // --- the Increment-1 integration umbrella (the Wave-7 capability) --------------------------
536 /** The FULL Increment-1 deterministic canary set over a WHOLE Gandalf v1 advisor output — the
537  *  Wave-7 integration gate. This is "the canary set = the test suite" expressed as one call: a
538  *  conformant Gandalf v1 output must pass EVERY Increment-1 canary at once. It composes, in order:
539  *    • assertConformant      — schema shape + reasoning-before-verdict + nitpick/elevation caps
540  *    • assertDiagnoseSeam    — B5  (diagnose exclusive to the vetted core)
541  *    • assertSituateSeam     — SITUATE honesty cap (no self-CORROBORATED; unverifiable → handoff)
542  *    • assertCeiling         — B-ceiling (single-family ⇒ max tier PROMISING)
543  *    • assertRefutationSeam  — B-honesty (named-defeater + provenance, or stamped SPECULATIVE)
544  *    • assertAnticipateSeam  — B3 + B9 (bounded premortem; forward-looking future-state)
545  *    • assertScoreLabelSeam  — B1 + B6 + B8 (zero ideation; no silent degradation; honest synthesis)
546  *  Throws on the FIRST canary a fixture violates. By construction this gate imports NOTHING from the
547  *  ADVISORY layer (seam/oracle.mjs, seam/anti-laundering.mjs): the deterministic done-floor is
548  *  provably independent of oracle/judge reachability and of the (BLOCKED-this-cycle) content-binding
549  *  canaries — PRINCIPLE-D. */
550 export function assertIncrement1Conformant(output) {
551   assertConformant(output);     // schema + reasoning-before-verdict + caps
552   assertDiagnoseSeam(output);   // B5
553   assertSituateSeam(output);    // SITUATE honesty cap
554   assertCeiling(output);        // B-ceiling
555   assertRefutationSeam(output); // B-honesty
556   assertAnticipateSeam(output); // B3 + B9
557   assertScoreLabelSeam(output); // B1 + B6 + B8
558 }
559 
560 // --- umbrella conformance check (used by the schema-conformance suite) ------------------
561 export function assertConformant(output) {
562   assertSchemaConformant(output);
563   assertReasoningBeforeVerdict(output, '$');
564   for (const [arr, name] of [[output.findings, 'findings'], [output.nitpicks, 'nitpicks'], [output.elevations, 'elevations']]) {
565     if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
566       arr.forEach((item, i) => {
567         if (item && typeof item === 'object' && 'reasoning' in item && 'verdict' in item) {
568           assertReasoningBeforeVerdict(item, `$.${name}[${i}]`);
569         }
570       });
571     }
572   }
573   assertCaps(output);
574 }
